_comment: VEXON Med · VO2 max testing reel. Cut to the reference TikTok sound: 105.25 BPM (beat 0.570 s), kick every 2 beats; reel 0:00 = song 0:05.05 (first kick).
title: VEXON · VO2 max testing · Storyboard
music_note: Cut to the TikTok sound at 105.25 BPM. Reel 0:00 = song 0:05 (first kick). Exported silent; add the sound in-app.

shots.name: HOOK · rider
shots.note: Full-body rider on the first kick. Title slams in, centred; footage carries the open.

shots.name: HOOK · mask macro
shots.note: Whip into a tight macro of the VO₂ mask (crop of the side angle). 'VO₂ MAX' lands on this cut.

shots.name: EQUIPMENT · pointer
shots.note: Mask being worn. One circle draws around the mask; thin leader line and small tag.

shots.name: EQUIPMENT · mask fit
shots.note: Second mask crop: head + harness straps, camera push-in.

shots.name: EQUIPMENT · connection
shots.note: Technician checking the arm sensor / setup. Tight crop.

shots.name: TEST · breathing
shots.note: Side angle, test in progress. Brackets lock onto the mask on beat 2.

shots.name: TEST · real-time
shots.note: Live monitor screen. Scan line sweeps the display (real footage values only, nothing added).

shots.name: MEASURE · effort
shots.note: Rider pushing harder, technician watching. Data lines start drawing (no values).

shots.name: MEASURE · upper body
shots.note: Upper-body crop: mask, shoulders, breathing. Lines keep rising.

shots.name: MEASURE · technician
shots.note: Technician overseeing with tablet. Lines complete.

shots.name: CLOSE · CTA
shots.text: Know your numbers. Measure what matters.
shots.note: Participant + technician at the bike. Slow pull-out, slow-mo, text holds 3.4 s.

shots.name: END SLOT
shots.note: Clean navy slot for the client's logo.
